question: In the closed-FRW V(phi)=0 control sector, does a classical local on-shell relational endpoint action for the static trace gauge P=0 exist, and is the time-dependent trace gauge P=f(s) an exactly gauge-related representative once the endpoint action, finite endpoint flow, and local FP measure are included?

repository_sources.role: prior exact discriminator that kept the local trace constraint-gauge fiber but killed appending a static trace delta to the unchanged proper-time finite source
Lorentzian closed-FRW constraint and lapse-sign convention
proper-time BFV endpoint conditions and surviving lapse modulus whose source is not silently reused here
fixed-parameter modulus and zero-lapse distributional boundary that remain outside this local endpoint calculation
endpoint-polarization obstruction and the distinction between a local clock diagnostic and a completed source

primary_sources.source: Henneaux, Teitelboim and Vergara, Gauge invariance for generally covariant systems, Nucl. Phys. B 387 (1992) 391, arXiv:hep-th/9205092
primary_sources.used_for: endpoint boundary terms, gauge-related endpoint states, canonical-gauge transversality, finite endpoint gauge transformations, and the canonical-limit FP structure
primary_sources.not_used_for: a global trace-gauge theorem, a full off-shell BFV construction for this repository model, or equality with the existing fixed-a kernel

primary_sources.source: Banihashemi and Jacobson, On the lapse contour, Phys. Rev. D 111, 066014 (2025), arXiv:2405.10307
primary_sources.used_for: the constraint-plus-gauge FP measure and the local trace-momentum-gauge premise before a lower-lateral momentum-first prescription
primary_sources.not_used_for: endpoint completion, a global maximal-slicing result, or a claim that the spatially flat V=0 degeneracy applies to the curved closed-FRW control used here

primary_sources.source: Marolf, Path integrals and instantons in quantum gravity: Minisuperspace models, Phys. Rev. D 53 (1996) 6979, arXiv:gr-qc/9602019
primary_sources.used_for: the full-real-lapse constraint projector as the still-uncomputed comparison target
primary_sources.not_used_for: identifying this local FP reduction with the full projector matrix element

model.phase_space: Q=2*log(a), P=a*p_a/2, phi, p with {Q,P}={phi,p}=1 and a=exp(Q/2)>0
model.static_gauge: P=0 with relational endpoint data Phi_star
model.benchmark: p=+1 on the p>0 connected component, P1=1/4, P2=1/2, hence R>=5/2 and D>0 throughout

exact_plan.reduced_endpoint_action: B_red=P, so S_imp=S0-[P] for fixed relational Phi_star endpoint data
exact_plan.static_endpoint_transversality: the original fixed-Q chart has C_P=0 at P=0, while the swapped gauge chart uses derivative -C_Q=D and is transverse on the declared component
exact_plan.local_fp_measure: on D>0, dQ dP dphi dp delta(C) delta(P-f) D=dPhi_star dp
exact_plan.orbit_triangle: T=integral(P1 to P2)dP/D, mu_i=integral(P_i to 0)dP/D, and T+mu_2-mu_1=0
exact_plan.action_triangle: S0_raw_td=P2-P1, F_i=-P_i, the actual endpoint correction is [F]_1^2=F2-F1=-(P2-P1), and S_rel=S0_raw_td+[F]_1^2=0
exact_plan.variational_problem_separation: the verdict concerns fixed relational Phi_star with S0-[P]; the auxiliary fixed-(P,phi) action S0-[P*Q] alone has H_red=+dot(f)*Q_star

decision_table.condition: all shell, Dirac-coordinate, one-form, transversality, finite-flow, local-FP, gauge-preservation, orbit-triangle, and improved-action checks pass
decision_table.meaning: Keep the classical local V=0 on-shell relational endpoint action of the static trace slice; retain the time-dependent representative as an exact same-constraint-orbit control, not as an independent promotion or quantum endpoint-state completion.

decision_table.condition: the static relational endpoint or finite boundary-generator identities fail while D remains nonzero and the time-dependent preservation and orbit identities pass
decision_table.meaning: Reject this static endpoint construction but retain only the separately derived time-dependent candidate.

decision_table.condition: R is nonpositive, D vanishes, the static hit is nonunique on the fixed benchmark, or gauge preservation fails
decision_table.meaning: Reject both representatives on the frozen benchmark.

decision_table.condition: the exact checks do not select a prior row
decision_table.meaning: Leave the local endpoint route open without promotion.

computed_scope: exact closed-FRW V=0 constraint-shell reduction in the frozen p=+1, R>0, D>0 connected component
local relational endpoint coordinate and on-shell symplectic potential
finite endpoint flow to the static trace slice
time-dependent gauge preservation and exact orbit/action triangles
independent high-precision quadrature of the finite flow parameters
not_computed: a full off-shell canonical transformation and ghost/antighost/b endpoint construction
the full m=2 BFV measure or gauge fermion
equality with the existing fixed-(a,phi) kernel or its constant-lapse finite discretization
the full-real-lapse Marolf projector matrix element
the Banihashemi-Jacobson momentum integral and lapse-contour interchange in the replacement source
global orbit coverage, a fundamental region, Gribov-copy census, determinant-line orientation, or all scalar-momentum sectors
physical original cycle, global n_sigma, a physics claim, or a TOE claim
